messages:
ben: hey all, first week here :wave: running the sample infra PR and Buildkite step that calls GH Actions via repo_dispatch keeps failing with a 403. snippet: 

```
2024-08-01T11:04:12Z ERROR trigger: POST https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/ingest/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches 403 Forbidden - resource not accessible by integration
```

I can see the repo and pipeline but unsure which GitHub app permission I'm missing. who owns the Buildkite app install? @maya?

maya: welcome! :tada: that 403 usually means the GitHub App used by Buildkite isn't installed on that repo (or it lacks workflow permissions). can you paste the pipeline step doing the dispatch?

ben: here it is from infra/pipelines/ingest.yml:

```
- command: |
    curl -s -X POST \
      -H \"Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json\" \
      -H \"Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN\" \
      https://api.github.com/repos/redwood-inference/ingest/actions/workflows/ci.yml/dispatches \
      -d '{\"ref\":\"main\"}'
```

infra-bot: scanning org installs... Buildkite GitHub App present. Current mode: selected repositories. ingest not included. tagging @ops-syl to add repo to install.

ops-syl: added ingest to the Buildkite app allowed list. should take ~20-40s to propagate. re-run the job when ready.

ci-tooling: buildkite/job/5543 re-run requested by ops-syl

ben: re-ran and repo_dispatch now returns 204, GH Actions queued. thanks!! :raised_hands:

maya: onboarding checklist for you: 1) open a 1-line PR to infra/permissions.md documenting which repos need the Buildkite app for repo_dispatchs; 2) wrap this curl in scripts/dispatch.sh and log the HTTP status for faster triage (eg `curl -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null`).

ben: will do. two quick q's: how do I request `ci-admins` team access, and where's the re-run & artifacts guide?

maya: request team access via #people-ops; docs are at https://internal.redwood/docs/ci/buildkite-runbook and /ci/artifacts. ping @infra-bot if you hit flaky cache issues and include job id + `buildkite-agent artifact download` output.

ben: great, thanks everyone — super quick support. i'll open the PR and tag you on it.

maya: welcome aboard! if anything else blocks bootcamp tasks DM me and i'll pair. :coffee:
